<custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-0">:person_with_crown:</custom> **User Story:**

**As a** customer,  
**I want** to view detailed information about a product,  
**so that** I can make an informed purchasing decision.

## Product Detail Page - MVP Template

[https://www.figma.com/design/gDN7wlDFp5mwXQfRDhotzR/Ambiendo---sunny?node-id=1-2](https://www.figma.com/design/gDN7wlDFp5mwXQfRDhotzR/Ambiendo---sunny?node-id=1-2) 

| **Product Information Display** The page must show the product name, price, short description, and high-quality images. A longer product description and technical specifications (if applicable) should be available. |  |
| --- | --- |
| **Image Gallery** Users can click through multiple product images. |  |
| **Variants** If the product has variants (e.g., size, color), buttons should allow the user to select these options. The page should update the price, image, or availability according to the selected variant. |  |
| **Stock Status** Show whether the product is in stock, low stock, or out of stock. **Shipping and Returns Info** Display estimated delivery time  |  |
| **Add to Cart Functionality** Users can add the product to their cart by selecting the desired variant (if applicable) and quantity. Clicking "Add to Cart" gives immediate feedback (e.g., cart sheet opens TBA). |  |
| **Related Products Section** Display recommended or similar products below the main content and after the first content slot |  |
|  |  |

# Product Image Gallery

<custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-1">:person_with_crown:</custom> **User Story:**

**As a** user browsing a product detail page,  
**I want** to view high-quality images of the product and easily navigate between them,  
**so that** I can evaluate the product visually before making a purchase decision.

### **Functional Requirements**

* Support a minimum of 1-n images per product.
* Image types supported: JPEG, PNG, WebP.
* Responsive scaling of images with optimization for loading speed (lazy loading recommended).
* Support for videos or 360° views as additional media items (optional).
* Fallback behavior if images fail to load (e.g.,

message).
* Gallery image background color is choosable

### **Non-Functional Requirements**

* **Performance**: Gallery should load and become interactive in under 1 second.
* **Responsiveness**: Must work seamlessly across all modern browsers and screen sizes.
* **Accessibility**: Fully WCAG 2.1 AA compliant.
* **Localization**: Support left-to-right and right-to-left languages.
* **Analytics**: Track image interactions (e.g., clicks, swipes, zooms).

| **Mobile** [https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=17128-56486&t=BOliaBnue2cyHxsi-4](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=17128-56486&t=BOliaBnue2cyHxsi-4)  |  |

| **Layout & Navigation:** Display a single image at a time with swipeable or tappable interaction. It is possible for the customer to decide how an image should be displayed in the Gallery. Either as a **full width image or with padding**. No thumbnails to save screen space. [Slider navigation numbers](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=7368-16086&t=FEQ6vrNodsWoLM08-4) (pagination indicators) to indicate position in carousel and for navigation if there is only one image, hide navigation and indicator Fullscreen modal option when tapping on the image or glass icon button The lightbox/fullscreen modal contains swipeable thumbnails | ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=e88a8917-9275-4993-9b6d-8b3d1d4ef610&&collection=&height=417&occurrenceKey=null&width=875&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)  |

# Buy Box 

Displays different components related to the product, variants, price etc.

<custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-3">:person_with_crown:</custom> **User Story:**

**As a** customer,  
**I want** to see a clearly visible and interactive buy box on the product detail page,  
**so that** I can easily select the desired product options and proceed to purchase without confusion.

---

## Buy Box requirements:

| **Requires**: Product Title & Basic Info Price Info Variant Selection Energy Label Info Quantity Picker & CTA Stock availability & Shipping Info Quantity discount box Benefits |  |
| --- | --- |
| **Responsive Design** Must be fully responsive and optimized for mobile, tablet, and desktop views. **Accessibility** All interactive elements must be keyboard navigable. Comply with WCAG 2.1 AA standards (e.g., proper labels for screen readers).  |  |

### **Non-Functional Requirements**

* **Performance**: The buy box must load in under 1 second after page render.
* **Analytics**: Track interactions like add-to-cart clicks, variant selections, and quantity changes.
* **Localization**: Support multiple languages and currencies depending on the user's region.
* **Fallbacks**: If data (e.g., stock info) cannot be loaded, show a graceful fallback or message.

enrichedData.purpose: Enables customers to view comprehensive product information including images, variants, pricing, and stock status to make informed purchasing decisions
useCases: Display product name, price, description, and high-quality images
Navigate through multiple product images in a gallery with thumbnail navigation
View images in a fullscreen lightbox with zoom and pan functionality
Select product variants such as size and color using swatches or buttons
Show unavailable variant combinations as disabled with tooltips
Display current price with discounts and original price struck through
Show stock availability status and estimated delivery time
Select product quantity using a stepper input with stock limits
Add product to cart with immediate feedback
Display energy label information in a lightbox modal
Show volume discount tiers for bulk purchases
Display shipping and benefit information with customizable icons
Handle products with many variant combinations via off-canvas selection panel
